algorithms.name: Fenwick Tree
algorithms.mentalModel: Each Fenwick index owns an aligned power-of-two block ending at itself. Queries consume owned blocks to the left; updates climb through larger blocks containing the changed point.
weaknesses: Recognizing offline transformations where Fenwick stores 0/1 representatives rather than the requested quantity directly
Coordinate-compression boundary semantics: lower_bound vs upper_bound

D0.title: Count of Smaller Numbers After Self
D0.focus: Coordinate compression + right-to-left prefix frequency counting

D1.title: Range Sum Query - Mutable
D1.focus: Cold implementation recall: point update + prefix/range sum

D5.title: Create Sorted Array through Instructions
D5.focus: Recognition: dynamic counts of values smaller/greater than the current value

D7.title: Salary Queries
D7.focus: Redo the hardest compression/boundary weakness without old code

D15.title: Reverse Pairs
D15.focus: Mixed recognition: decide whether Fenwick + compression is appropriate before coding

D25.title: Count of Range Sum
D25.focus: Retention test: transform prefix inequalities into ordered frequency queries
